newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan plans to auction one bln rupees bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan plans to auction one bln rupees bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Tuesday it had invited tenders by Thursday for the auction of six-month short-term Federal Bonds worth one billion rupees.
Tenders will be opened on Thursday and the results announced on Friday, a bank statement said.
It said successful bidders must deposit the amount of accepted bids on Monday. "Bids can be rejected without assigning any reason."
The pre-auction target is 1.0 billion rupees, the bank said. ($1 = 40.22 rupees) -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
